clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother's worry over money began in March 1988 and she stopped talking with your father about it by May 1988; your brother's grades fell in November 1989; your mother grew calmer once back at work by March 1990. The shifts in anxiety, distance, and functioning cluster around the death, with your mother's money worry and distance from your father opening some months before and settling as she returned to work after the loss.

clusters.name: Your mother Della told she had breast cancer, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around your mother Della's diagnosis of breast cancer in February 1995, within the following months: your migraines kept you in bed starting in March 1994, about six months before the diagnosis; you called your brother most nights in April 1994, then stopped returning his calls in June 1995 after your mother's diagnosis; you stopped calling home in February 1996. Your symptom, your closeness to your brother, and your distance from your mother shifted in the same months as the diagnosis and its aftermath, with the moves between you and your brother marking a turn from toward to away as your mother's illness took hold.
